decisions.reason: Product A builds on the firm's established dumper and construction equipment knowledge, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
Product B builds on the firm's established construction dumper knowledge, so the firm can assimilate feedback and refine it.
Product C is distant from the firm's established offer, so despite in-house R&D the firm lacks the related knowledge to interpret early results and learn from them.
Product D builds on the firm's established loader and lifting knowledge, so the firm can use its absorptive capacity to improve it.
